target: Zero-effort, pasted raw model output with obvious, nameable AI smells. This is not general AI authorship detection; careful/edited AI-assisted text without smells is out of scope.
rule: True only when the candidate wording supports a concrete reader-facing surface label: assistant residue, generated scaffold, stock opener/closer, recognizable cliche, canned review praise, or an inflated vocabulary/phrase component. A label must describe the words shown, without referring to a statistical AI/human difference. False for ordinary function-word/grammar fragments, neutral subject words, and normal isolated adjectives without a clear stock smell. True is review eligibility, never a verdict; generic praise/idioms can be human and require corroboration. Existing topic and veto flags still apply.

true.title:: Generated title-label scaffold; also an ordinary human heading
true.unforgettable: Inflated canned review praise; vocabulary component
true.heartwarming: Canned sentimental review praise; vocabulary component
true.masterpiece: Superlative canned review praise; vocabulary component
